$:set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p terminal/tasks/fishFry
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry-pillow-venv
/tmp/fishfry-pillow-venv/bin/pip -q install Pillow
curl -fLsS --max-time 30 'https://assets.katomcdn.com/q_auto%2Cf_auto/v1637700341/products/080/080-APZS12/080-apzs12.jpg' -o /tmp/fishfry-source.jpg
/tmp/fishfry-pillow-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import base64, json
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from pathlib import Path
source = Image.open('/tmp/fishfry-source.jpg').convert('RGB')
source = source.resize((1476, 1536), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS) if source.size != (1476, 1536) else source
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(source)
draw.line((915,55,560,55), fill='black', width=8)
draw.polygon([(560,55),(596,37),(596,73)], fill='black')
source.save('/tmp/fishfry-annotated.jpg', quality=95)
rotated = Image.open('/tmp/fishfry-annotated.jpg').transpose(Image.Transpose.ROTATE_270)
path = Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png')
rotated.save(path)
payload = {'message':'Add 90-degree clockwise fish-fry pizza-screen image', 'content':base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode('ascii')}
Path('/tmp/fishfry-put.json').write_text(json.dumps(payload))
print('PREPARED', path, rotated.size, 'bytes', path.stat().st_size)
PY
TARGET='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_arrow_90_clockwise.png'
gh api --method PUT "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$TARGET" --input /tmp/fishfry-put.json --jq '{commit: .commit.sha, path: .content.path, size: .content.size}'
gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$TARGET" --jq '{path: .path, size: .size, sha: .sha}'
